Some songs have a special magic that stays in your heart forever! Enjoy “Meri Jaan Mujhpe Tu Jaadu Sa Kar Gayi” from the 1985 Hindi film Ram Tere Kitne Nam, featuring the talented Sanjeev Kumar and the beautiful Rekha. With the distinctive musical charm of R. D. Burman, this song takes you back to the memorable era of 1980s Bollywood music
